stations.title: The hut's program

stations.title: Ticket package
stations.text: The only place a fare is worked out.

captions: The ticket hut's code. Bridie wants the fares where only the ticket code can reach.
Everything sits in one heap, so the hut could make up a fare of its own.
You split it into packages: the fares and tickets in one, the hut in another.
Now the hut makes tickets and prints them, and every fare comes from one place.
Packages, import, public and javac -d. Part 3 is done: the program has its parts.
